verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single docs line saying Appwrite's managed database APIs come "with permissions" (appwrite-docs-23), which implies some access control. Nothing shows per-user or per-row restriction, or how such rules are defined. Missing for 10: documentation of per-user/per-row permission rules, how rules are defined and enforced, role/team-based access examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
